name: Demons Gate
source:
There is a gate that clocks demons invasion into the human world. The gate is inside human shrine maiden body. The gate can not be opened unless girl wants to throw away virginity herself. The great demon sends a smaller demon to the human world in order to temp the maiden every night.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一扇门控制着恶魔入侵人类世界。门在人类巫女体内。除非女孩想自己放弃童贞，否则大门不能打开。大恶魔每晚都会派遣小恶魔来到人间诱惑少女。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
